bhajan.title: Amrutha Sai Naama Akhanda Sai Prema

discourse.excerpt: As you grow in years, detachment too should grow; as time passes by, the fruit must get ripe and become sweet.
discourse.theme: Grow in detachment as you grow in years — let life ripen like fruit, and let your words carry love, not envy.
discourse.title: Are words mere sound?

reflection: Swami says detachment should grow with the years, as fruit ripens and turns sweet — and warns that vanity, envy and egoism cut at the root of our real nature. Today, speak one kind, true word where a sharp or envious one would come easier. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 12 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Use your words as an offering today — praise someone's success sincerely, with no envy, and mean every word.
